title: ConnectX Self-Play Game Logs
subtitle: 400 Connect Four games: heuristic agent vs random and negamax, move by move
description:
## Context
Game logs generated locally with `kaggle-environments` for the Kaggle **ConnectX** simulation competition (6x7 board, 4 in a row).

A simple heuristic agent (win if possible, else block, else play closest to the center) played 100 games as first player and 100 games as second player against each of the built-in `random` and `negamax` agents.

## Content
- `games.csv`: one row per game with players and result.
- `moves.csv`: one row per move, in order.

Join the two files on `game_id`.

## Use cases
- Analyse first-player advantage.
- Train a move-prediction or value model.
- Opening statistics (which first columns win most).

## Collection methodology
Generated with `kaggle_environments.make('connectx').run([...])`, kaggle-environments 1.33.2, Python 3.12, October 2026.

## License
CC0: public domain.
